thread:
Amy C: Quick sync — we need to finalize the enterprise provisioning checklist for compliance sprint. Customers keep asking about audit log fidelity + BYO-KMS handshake details. 
Marco L: +1. Do we have firm launch criteria for SOC2/ISO customers?
Deepak S: For SOC2 we promised immutable audit logs, 90d hot-index, 7y cold archive option, and key custody controls (BYOK).
Jen R: Can we scope the MVP so Dedicated + Private get BYOK, hosted gets envelope keys in v1? customers will push for BYOK for hosted though.
Sara P: Legal says hosted BYOK in v1 is risky without escrow/KMS escrow. We should avoid promising full hosted BYOK until escrow is defined.
Amy C: So for MVP: Dedicated & Private full BYOK, Hosted envelope + audit-level metadata. Launch criteria draft: 1) Keystore handshake doc, 2) Audit export format stable, 3) Retention SLAs documented, 4) Regression tests for telemetry. Agree? :thinking_face:
Marco L: Agree. Add 5) Ops runbook for key-rotation incidents and 6) Performance SLOs with 99th pct latency targets.
Deepak S: Handshake steps (high level):
```
1. Customer generates key material (HSM/KMS) and shares public key or wrapping key policy
2. Operator runs handshake: verify attestation, store key reference (no plaintext)
3. On call, support key rotation with replayable audit markers
```
We need to add automated attestation checks.
Jen R: Ops runbook should include explicit escrow flow for Legal hold: how to export encrypted evidence, where keys live, who can trigger.
Sara P: Legal hold requirement: export must include verifiable chain-of-custody metadata (user id, request id, signed time). Add that to audit schema.
Marco L: On audit schema - propose v1 fields: ts, tenant_id, route, model_version, request_id, user_id (nullable), keystore_ref, event_hash. Keep payload minimal to avoid PII.
Amy C: Good. Need product-owner signoff by Fri to keep this sprint. Who owns keystore handshake doc? Deepak?
Deepak S: I’ll own the handshake doc + attestations. Need help from eng-sre for perf tests. @ops-bot can we schedule a perf-run for audit write throughput next week?
ops-bot: perf-run scheduled: audit-write-throughput 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC. Traces will be posted to #eng-sre.
Jen R: I'll draft the Legal hold export runbook and a sample export JSON. Amy — I'll share by Thursday.
Sara P: I'll work with Legal to define escrow acceptance criteria and an escalation matrix.
Marco L: One more ask — telemetry gating: if audit pipeline lag > 2min we fall back to local buffered writes + alert. Add that to SRE playbook.
Amy C: Ok final checklist for product signoff: handshake doc, audit schema v1, retention SLAs doc, ops runbook w/ perf SLOs, legal hold export spec. I'll collate and send to exec for approval. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Marco L: FYI — customer X asked for 30d vs 90d hot index option. We'll include tiering note but not promise per-tenant hot tiers in MVP.
Deepak S: Noted. We'll include tiering as roadmap item 2.
Amy C: Closing: next sync Wed 10am PT. If anything blocks signoff ping me.
Sara P: 👍
